cause_quote: Changing the guard to `if (revisions.get(id) !== captured && facts?.transcriptAssistantMessage === "unknown")` let a superseded backfill publish when broad invalidation had cleared `facts`.
user_saw: A session preview could revert to older assistant text when a background read finished after broad invalidation.
summary: The gateway now discards every superseded transcript backfill before it can overwrite the session preview.
reasoning: I checked that broad invalidation already cleared retained facts and removed the backfill revision in the parent of #175534. The parent’s `=== undefined` check discarded the stale result in that state, while the new `=== "unknown"` check let it fall through and publish the old text, matching the sequence in the fix’s regression test.
